summary: The toy 3D aesthetic remains consistent with smooth rendering and readable typography throughout. Minor hand-object alignment and framing crop issues occur in close-up shots.

clean: Consistent toy3d character anatomy with floating sphere hands
Props like the yerba packages and mate gourds scale plausibly with characters
unclean: shot 4: The pour stream from the thermos does not clearly align with the gourd opening
shot 10: Character head is aggressively cropped behind graphic cards

clean: Text cards and captions remain legible and centered
Lighting and palette maintain a clean, sunny toy-like environment
unclean: shot 10: UI header overlays tightly against facial features
shot 12: Large empty dark space beneath the interactive poll elements

issues.problem: Thermos pour trajectory misses gourd center slightly
issues.fix: Re-aim the spout directly above the gourd opening

issues.problem: Text banners crowd and overlap top of the head
issues.fix: Pull camera back slightly to preserve head silhouette

issues.problem: Floating ball hands hover unnaturally wide without props
issues.fix: Bring idle hands closer to torso rest position

learnings.rule: Avoid cropping character foreheads directly beneath multi-line text cards.
Align pouring spouts vertically above liquid targets for convincing flow physics.
